Description: Enables Proton/Wine full debug log output written to ~/steam-438100.log
Notes: Useful for diagnosing Proton/VRChat launch failures. Creates large log files

Description: Overrides the directory where Proton log files are written
Notes: e.g. PROTON_LOG_DIR=/tmp — prevents log clutter in home directory

Description: Enables NVIDIA NVAPI DLL emulation for DLSS and NVIDIA-specific features
Notes: Required for DLSS inside Proton; may help SteamVR integration

Description: Enables D9VK (Vulkan-based Direct3D 9) renderer instead of DXVK
Notes: Experimental; try if D3D9 games have issues under DXVK

Description: Enables seccomp-based syscall sandboxing for Proton processes
Notes: Disable (set 0) if game crashes immediately on launch

Description: Forces 4GB address space support for 32-bit process (LAA flag)
Notes: Helps prevent OOM crashes in memory-intensive content

Description: Hides NVIDIA GPU from the game and reports it as AMD instead
Notes: Workaround for NVIDIA-exclusive paths causing crashes

Description: Wine debug channel configuration — comma-separated list of channel:level pairs
Notes: e.g. WINEDEBUG=-all,+openxr — very verbose; use vrclient for VRChat-specific Wine logs

Description: Wine DLL override map in format dllname=native,builtin
Notes: Separate multiple with semicolons. iyuv_32= fixes video codec issues in VRChat

Description: Overrides the Wine prefix directory path for this game session
Notes: Usually not needed — Steam sets this automatically for Proton games

Description: Exposes host machine OpenXR runtime JSON files inside the Steam container
Notes: Needed for WiVRn, Monado, or other host OpenXR runtimes to work

Description: Grants read-write access to specific host paths inside the pressure-vessel container
Notes: /var/lib/flatpak/app/io.github.wivrn.wivrn — needed for WiVRn flatpak socket access

Description: Shows DXVK Vulkan overlay with GPU/frame timing stats
Notes: Combine with commas: DXVK_HUD=fps,gpus,memory — useful for performance profiling

Description: Enables asynchronous shader compilation in DXVK to reduce stutter
Notes: May cause visual artifacts during shader warmup but reduces frame stutters

Description: Caps DXVK frame rate to specified value (frames per second)
Notes: 0=uncapped. Overrides in-game frame limiter via Vulkan layer

Description: Enables DXVK pipeline state cache for faster shader reuse between sessions
Notes: Disable if you have persistent shader bugs after game updates

Description: Configures VKD3D (D3D12→Vulkan) behavior via comma-separated flags
Notes: dxr11=Enables DXR ray tracing; nodxr=Forces off ray tracing

Description: Enables experimental VKD3D feature flags (bitmask)
Notes: See VKD3D docs for individual bit values

Description: Enables MangoHUD performance overlay on top of VRChat
Notes: GPU/CPU/RAM/FPS overlay. Install mangohud separately. Use MANGOHUD_CONFIG to configure

Description: Configures MangoHUD overlay display options (comma-separated)
Notes: e.g. fps,gpu_stats,cpu_stats,ram

Description: Wraps VRChat inside the gamescope compositor for resolution/refresh control
Notes: e.g. gamescope -W 2560 -H 1440 -r 90 -- %command%

Description: Enables GameMode (game performance daemon) for VRChat session
Notes: Use gamemoderun %command% to enable; requires gamemode package

Description: Enables vkBasalt post-processing layer (sharpening/color grading) on top of VRChat
Notes: Install vkbasalt; configure via /etc/vkBasalt.conf or VKBASALT_CONFIG_FILE

Description: Specifies path to specific Vulkan ICD driver JSON file (overrides default GPU)
Notes: e.g. /usr/share/vulkan/icd.d/nvidia_icd.json — use to force specific GPU

Description: Alternative to VK_ICD_FILENAMES — specifies Vulkan driver JSON files
Notes: e.g. /usr/share/vulkan/icd.d/radeon_icd.x86_64.json

Description: Enables experimental RADV (AMD Vulkan) performance options
Notes: e.g. gpl=Enables GPL for faster shaders; rt=Enables ray tracing

Description: Forces AMD Vulkan ICD selection between AMDVLK and RADV
Notes: RADV is generally preferred for gaming

Description: Overrides Vulkan window surface present mode (vsync behavior)
Notes: mailbox=low-latency,immediate=no-vsync,fifo=vsync
